name: Input Stage
description: Receives raw ICD CSV and Markdown narrative files from operator and canonicalizes them

name: Processing Stage
description: Validates inputs against schema and produces canonical graph JSON

name: Output Stage
description: Returns canonical graph JSON to orchestrator state machine

name: File Ingestion Handler
description: Receives raw ICD CSV and Markdown narrative bytes from HTTP multipart upload

name: Schema Validator
description: Validates ICD CSV columns (entity_type id name description parent etc) and Markdown structure

name: CSV and Markdown Parser
description: Parses CSV rows into entity/interface tuples; extracts sections from markdown narrative

name: LLM Prompt Handler
description: Constructs system and user prompts for Agent 01 LLM call; sends to adapter

name: LLM Adapter Interface
description: Calls external LLM or fixture adapter to normalize parsed inputs into canonical JSON

name: Canonical Graph Builder
description: Transforms normalized LLM output into schema-compliant canonical graph with all required fields

name: Output Validation
description: Validates generated canonical graph against canonical schema; ensures no unsupported fields

name: State Emitter
description: Returns canonical graph JSON to orchestrator for downstream Agent 02
User file upload (ICD CSV + Markdown bytes)
Parsed CSV rows and markdown sections
LLM prompt with parsed inputs context
LLM response with canonical graph JSON
Validated canonical graph ready for Agent 02
Agent 01 stage completion signal to HITL gate (if enabled)
